glosses: to correspond, to conform, to agree, to comply, to be in line with, to fit
to give in to (to relent, yield, surrender to)
to take an interest in, to get carried away by
to feel attracted to, to fall in love with
to get seduced by, to succumb to the temptation of, not to be able to resist

o.text: From Proto-Turkic *ud- (“to follow, conform”). Compare Turkish uymak.
Izafet II compound of kütləvi (“mass”) + informasiya (“information”) + vasitə (“mean”). Calque of Russian сре́дство ма́ссовой информа́ции (srédstvo mássovoj informácii)
Izafet II compound of soxulcan + dəlik. Calque of English wormhole.
